mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS music_id, m.mbid, m.title, m.artist, m.duration, m.location <-> #{point}::vector AS dist, (m.location::real[])[1] AS pc1, (m.location::real[])[2] AS pc2, (m.location::real[])[3] AS pc3, (m.location::real[])[4] AS pc4, (m.location::real[])[5] AS pc5, (m.location::real[])[6] AS pc6, (m.location::real[])[7] AS pc7, (m.location::real[])[8] AS pc8, (m.location::real[])[9] AS pc9, (m.location::real[])[10] AS pc10, (m.location::real[])[11] AS pc11, (m.location::real[])[12] AS pc12, (m.location::real[])[13] AS pc13, (m.location::real[])[14] AS pc14, (m.location::real[])[15] AS pc15, (m.location::real[])[16] AS pc16 FROM music m ORDER BY m.location <-> #{point}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
